players.product: Contracted hydro, wind, solar and battery-storage power for corporate and hyperscaler buyers, plus Westinghouse nuclear fuel, services and AP1000 reactors

quarterly_data.signal: Brookfield Renewable's Q2 2026 results release: it delivered ~1,280 MW of new capacity in the quarter, bringing completed new capacity so far this year to ~3,100 MW, which the company calls the highest first-half development total in its history, and it remains on track to deliver ~10,000 MW of new projects per year by 2027. It continues to advance major contracting initiatives, including a portfolio of hydro assets in Ontario as part of a broader re-contracting program run by the provincial system operator that will help secure cash flows from these assets. The release also cites strong performance from Westinghouse, with increasing activity across new-build projects and reactor restarts as global demand for nuclear power continues to accelerate.
quarterly_data.figure: ~3,100 MW delivered year to date; ~10,000 MW of new projects per year by 2027
